governance_decisions.decision: Use NATIVE_PRIMITIVE_CANDIDATE as default lane and do not exploit -VAN, final -I, PAR-, VAM-/VAMA-, SAR- or other observed families as productive morphology without a separate approved rule.
Each option exposes slot ID, concept reference, G-ID sequence, IPA, safe romanization, phonotactic result, collision margin and morphology-false-friend result.
Reject exact collisions against 33 recovered and all 60 authored registry entries including Wave 01; near collisions require review.
Wave 02 contains no HOLD-linked slots; this gate resolves no HOLD seed.
After generation prepare a separate Wave 02 human selection gate; generated options receive no registry status, HNK3000 credit, FROZEN authority, curriculum binding or runtime use.
